environment.heldout_semantics: phase-1 behavior never takes heldout pairs (resample among allowed); evaluation behavior samples uniformly over ALL actions, so heldout transitions and heldout alias patterns occur at evaluation
environment.phase1_stream: 800 steps, uniform-random over allowed actions, random start; rng = default_rng(seed)
environment.eval_sequences: 60 sequences x 50 steps per seed; behavior uniform over all actions; rng = default_rng(seed*7919+202)
environment.multi_step_prediction_needed: R_slice_5 horizon-4 targets diverge from horizon-1 targets (KL>0.01) on 100% of checked steps, all preregistered seeds
environment.lookup_triviality_assessment: not lookup-trivial: aliasing requires memory at every (o,a) cell; R4 restricts to never-seen 3-windows where window stores must miss; heldout transitions unseen by all stores
environment.controls_disabled_by_construction_assess: not disabled: all stores receive the full phase-1 stream; window/cache/table controls answer every query with predeclared fallbacks on miss; retrieval is expected to be competent on seen windows (R1 contains ~56-58% seen-window steps)

slices.R_slice_1: cache_free_heldout_sequence_prediction: fresh recomputed state, burn-in 5, score steps 6..49, horizon-1 exact expected NLL vs true kernel
slices.R_slice_2: hidden_state_cache_removed: state reset at step 25 with 5-step burn-in, score steps 31..49 (no persistent state across the reset)
slices.R_slice_3: longer_context_retrieval_removed: prediction state recomputed from only the last 10 steps (sliding window, in-window burn-in), score steps >= 11
slices.R_slice_4: heldout_alias_or_state_disambiguation: R1 protocol, scored ONLY at steps whose preceding (o,a) window of length w=3 never occurred in the phase-1 stream; w=3 chosen pre-anchor by predeclared balance rule (unseen fraction closest to 0.5 among {2,3}; measured 0.419-0.453 across seeds)
slices.R_slice_5: nonredundant_long_horizon_prediction: at steps 6..45 predict o_{t+4} by action-conditioned rollout (actions a_t..a_{t+3} given, no intermediate observations); exact expected NLL vs 4-step kernel product

prerun_redundancy_check.R4_not_equivalent_to_R1: scored-step subset fraction in [0.419, 0.453] (within predeclared validity band [0.05, 0.95]) for every seed
prerun_redundancy_check.R5_not_equivalent_to_R1: different prediction target (horizon 4 vs 1); target distributions diverge (KL>0.01) on 100% of steps

seed_policy.rule: five consecutive primes starting at 29, disjoint from parent task seeds; fixed before any run; no reruns, no selection, no dropping
seed_policy.aggregation: strict fallback rule: all metrics are exact expected NLL (deterministic given seed); candidate_advantage must be > 0 on every seed and every required slice against every mandatory control; ties or any nonpositive cell = control match

candidate_R.architecture: belief predictor: learned transition logits theta_T (16x3x16); observation map public interface; belief update b'(s') propto sum_s b(s) softmax(theta_T[s,a])(s') * 1[OBS_LABEL[s']=o']; init N(0,0.1) rng(seed*1000+13); SGD lr=0.05
candidate_R.training: phase-1 online single-step (800 updates) -> frozen snapshot -> replay event: chunks = contiguous length 40 stride 40 (20 chunks, chronological), burn_in_length=5, multi_step_depth=4 (preregistered to cover R5 horizon; loss = sum over horizons j=1..4 of NLL of o_{t+j} under action-conditioned rollout without intermediate observation conditioning), 4 epochs, 35 scored positions per chunk = 2800 replay updates; total 3600 update_steps
candidate_R.evaluation: isolated subprocess; forward path reads only [snapshot.npz, queries.json]; no chunk, cache, index, or store access; horizon-4 prediction by belief rollout

interpretation_locks.original_order_control: same_item_multiset_original_order is by definition the candidate's own configuration (identical multiset, loss, and order). A literally identical run has advantage exactly 0 and would make the card unsatisfiable. LOCKED READING (pre-anchor, before any run): original_order is implemented and reported as the candidate run itself; the order_geometry_collapse rule binds on the order-PERTURBED controls (shuffled / reverse / random), consistent with the card's acceptance list which names only shuffled_same_loss and reverse_order. This lock is recorded before any run and may not be reinterpreted after results.
interpretation_locks.retrieval_multistep_rollout: cache/retrieval controls natively predict one step. For R_slice_5 they roll out by chaining their own store-derived (o,a)->o' conditional over given future actions (exact distribution propagation over the 5 observation symbols). Table controls chain their estimated per-action obs-transition matrices exactly. Window-model baselines propagate exact joints over their window contents. Each control class uses its own best tractable chaining; no control borrows the candidate's latent model.
interpretation_locks.uniform_vs_random_replay: with iid item sampling these coincide up to belief-context reconstruction; both implemented from distinct seeded rngs; near-equivalence disclosed, not hidden

order_same_loss_2800_updates_k4: random_order_same_loss (single global chunk permutation drawn once, fixed across epochs, rng seed*1000+89)
generic_replay_candidate_arch: generic_chunk_replay (k=1, per-epoch uniform chunk order, rng seed*1000+90)
random_replay (k=1 at 2800 uniform timesteps, 10-step local belief recompute, rng seed*1000+99)
uniform_replay (k=1, iid item sampling, rng seed*1000+98)
equal_compute_extra_training (4 updates/sample + 1 extra on first 400 samples = 3600, no storage)
cache_retrieval: hidden_state_cache (longest-suffix 8->4->2 window match -> cached next-obs dist, uniform miss)
episodic_sequence_retrieval (longest exact suffix up to length 12, empirical dist, backoff to marginal)
graph_table: compressed_map (rank-3 truncated SVD of 15x5 count matrix, clip>=0 +1e-6, renormalize)
strong_function_approximation: same_architecture_no_multistep_loss (candidate arch, online + chrono single-step chunk replay 2800; identical to single_step_chunk_replay by construction - equivalence disclosed, both names reported)
larger_capacity_single_step_model (belief arch + LEARNED observation logits theta_O 16x5, 848 params vs 768; obs map not given; online + single-step replay, 3600 updates)
equal_parameter_budget_model (order-2 window model: logits over (code_{t-1},code_t)->o', code=o*3+a, 1125 params; online SGD + replay-equivalent extra passes to 3600 updates)
equal_compute_model (candidate arch, single-step only, per-sample repeats to 3600 updates, no storage)

stronger_sequence_model_without_multistep_consistency (interpolated order-1/2/3 window model with learned softmax interpolation weights; trained single-step, 3600 updates; h=4 by exact joint propagation)

control_parity.tuning_budget: none for candidate and all controls (all hyperparameters fixed in this record); control_tuning_budget >= candidate_tuning_budget satisfied
control_parity.compute_matching_basis: update_steps; candidate total 3600; all training-type controls matched to 3600 except where their definition fixes fewer (same_data_online_only 800, frozen_theta 0 - disclosed)
control_parity.implementation: shared model classes, shared init draws per seed, shared eval protocols; lookup/retrieval stores built from the identical phase-1 stream

competence_floors.retrieval: deterministic placeholder env (eps=0, seed 9001): sequence_lookup must achieve exact mode prediction on repeated patterns
competence_floors.generic_replay: uniform replay must strictly reduce training NLL vs pre-replay snapshot (seed 9001)
competence_floors.table: count_table must be exact-mode on deterministic placeholder
competence_floors.function_approximation: each FA baseline must strictly reduce its training NLL during learning (seed 9001)
